title: Difference-in-Differences Identification with Outcomes Released at Changing Levels of a Geographic Hierarchy
banked_reason: Decision and math referees passed, but the cold general referee capped the delivered fixed-tree known-covariance structural diagnostic at incremental because no named longitudinal release was verified; the validity gate confirmed that reaching field requires a new empirical research program.
gap_reasons: The note proves an exact identification and information decomposition only for a narrow finite, fixed-tree, fixed-mass, covering-antichain Gaussian experiment with known covariance.
The manuscript supplies no verified longitudinal release showing that this integrated object arises in practice.
Without that match the delivered package remains a specialized structural diagnostic rather than a field-level econometric contribution.

The directed route requires a new empirical research program: verify one named longitudinal release end-to-end, construct B, Γ, X, S, H, and J reproducibly, and demonstrate identification or strict variance gain.
proof_attempt_summary: The run derived a typed finite-tree visibility basis, constructive atomic-twin nonidentification criterion, fixed-design GLS result, and exact native-versus- harmonized information comparison; the decision and mathematics referees passed. The field claim collapsed because the model remained a narrow structural experiment with only synthetic witnesses and no verified named longitudinal release. Re-raising requires a new empirical audit with reproducible operators and a demonstrated gain, not another derivation pass over the existing theorem package.
tldr: Within the abstract class of finite stable-hierarchy designs, when longitudinal outcomes are released at different cuts of a stable administrative hierarchy, which causal comparisons survive aggregation, and what exactly is lost by first harmonizing every date to one common geography? The proposal seeks a complete weighted tree-Haar normal form for every aggregate contrast that cancels atomic and date effects, a signature-matrix characterization of target identification with same-law atomic twins on failure, and exact native-versus-harmonized information formulas. This would turn an ad hoc preprocessing choice into a target-specific identification and efficiency audit, while keeping known-covariance GLS itself explicitly classical. No named longitudinal release has yet been verified to satisfy all operators.
gap: Tree-wavelet work characterizes fixed spatial multiresolution coordinates; modern DiD work characterizes causal targets and temporal support; change-of-support models interpolate across incompatible maps; and hierarchical GLS or reconciliation combines noisy levels. The inspected literature does not characterize the complete nuisance-free experiment generated by changing hierarchical antichains or the target-specific information discarded by common-geography aggregation.
fill: Prove the visible-kernel theorem and mass-rational basis, reduce identification to the visible signature row space with constructive atomic twins, derive the exact general-covariance Schur complement and inverse-mass node sum, and give necessary-and-sufficient tests for matrix equality, new identification, and strict target-variance gain, followed by fixed-design GLS inference.
